text: NOMMOS — Restaurant Lounge, Tangier — Source: nommostanger.com (public menu, retrieved September 2026)

ABOUT
NOMMOS is a restaurant lounge on Tangier Bay with a view of the Mediterranean.
The decor is described as refined, blending tradition and modernity.
The kitchen serves Mediterranean and international cuisine, including steakhouse
meats and sushi. The venue hosts live cooking shows, live bands and DJ nights,
and takes bookings for private events.
PRACTICAL INFORMATION — Opening hours: Monday to Saturday from 7 pm to 2 am
PRACTICAL INFORMATION — Opening hours: Sunday from 1 pm to 2 am
PRACTICAL INFORMATION — Location: Tangier Marina Bay
PRACTICAL INFORMATION — Reservations: by phone, by WhatsApp, or through the booking widget on the website
PRACTICAL INFORMATION — All prices are in Moroccan dirhams (DH).
